message.content:
This is a mop bucket with a wringer, made of polypropylene. The likely candidates are 3924.90.56 (other household articles of plastics) or 9603.90 (hand-operated mechanical floor sweepers, mops, and brushes).

Heading 9603 covers mops, but a bucket sold with a wringer is not a mop. CBP rulings on mop buckets with wringers have classified them as household articles of plastics under 3924.90.5650. The importer also states that the plastic bucket gives the article its essential character. This points to heading 3924, which covers other household articles and hygienic or toilet articles of plastics.

The subheading is 3924.90.56: "Other: Other: Other." The 10-digit statistical code is 3924.90.5650.
